items.title: 2.11 Inelastic collision in two dimensions (do dimensions mein inelastic takkar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.11 with Fig. 2.17 (PDF 46-48, printed 43-45).

blocks.text: Macroscopic (aankh se nazar aane wali bari cheezon ke) collisions aam taur par inelastic hote hain aur kinetic energy conserve nahi karte.
Perfectly inelastic collision woh hai jis mein takrane wali cheezen chipak kar ek hi mass ban jati hain. Is ka analysis (tajziya) yun hai:

Do rigid (sakht) bodies lein jin ke mass m₁ aur m₂ hain aur jo xy-plane (two dimensions) mein v⃗₁i aur v⃗₂i velocities se chal rahi hain. Pehli body x-axis ke saath chal rahi hai aur doosri x-axis se angle θ bana kar. Dono origin par takrate hain (Fig. 2.17).

blocks.alt: Axes x aur y. Body m1 x-axis ke saath velocity v1i se origin ki taraf chalti hai; body m2 x-axis se angle theta wali line par velocity v2i se origin ki taraf. Origin par takra kar mili hui body velocity vf se x-axis se angle phi par oopar nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.17: Two dimensions mein perfectly inelastic collision (kitab ki Figure 2.17 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Collision ke baad dono chipak jati hain; combined mass M = m₁ + m₂ hai jo velocity v⃗f se x-axis ke saath angle φ bana kar chalta hai. Ab v⃗₂i ke rectangular components v⃗₂i sin θ aur v⃗₂i cos θ lein, aur v⃗f ke v⃗f sin φ aur v⃗f cos φ. (Equations mein pehli body ka angle θ₁ aur doosri ka θ₂ likha hai; pehli body x-axis par ho to θ₁ = 0.)
Momentum in the x-direction (x-direction mein momentum):

blocks.text_alt: m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂ = Mv⃗f cos φ   (2.39)

blocks.text: Momentum in the y-direction (y-direction mein momentum):

blocks.text_alt: m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂ = Mv⃗f sin φ   (2.40)

blocks.text: Solving for Final Velocity and Angle (final velocity aur angle nikaalna)
Magnitude of Final Velocity vf (final velocity ki magnitude):
Equations (2.39) aur (2.40) ka square le kar add karein (cos²φ + sin²φ = 1):

blocks.text_alt: vf = √([(m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂)/M]² + [(m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂)/M]²)   (2.41)

blocks.text: Final angle φ:
x-axis ke saath v⃗f ka angle φ nikalne ke liye y-momentum wali equation (2.40) ko x-momentum wali equation (2.39) se divide karein (sin φ / cos φ = tan φ):

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke φ equations (2.40) ko (2.41) se divide karne se milta hai. Sahi yeh hai ke y-momentum wali (2.40) ko x-momentum wali (2.39) se divide karein; (2.41) to vf ki magnitude hai.

blocks.text_alt: φ = tan⁻¹[(m₁v₁i sin θ₁ + m₂v₂i sin θ₂)/(m₁v₁i cos θ₁ + m₂v₂i cos θ₂)]   (2.42)

blocks.text: φ woh direction hai (x-axis ke saath angle) jis mein chipki hui dono bodies collision ke baad chalti hain. m₁, m₂, M, θ₁, θ₂, φ aur v⃗₁i, v⃗₂i, v⃗f ki values (2.39) aur (2.40) mein rakh kar is case mein momentum ka conservation prove kiya ja sakta hai.
Kinetic energy
Collision inelastic hai, is liye system ki kinetic energy conserved nahi rehti. Loss (nuqsan) yun nikalte hain:
Initial Kinetic Energy (shuru ki kinetic energy)
Collision se pehle system ki total kinetic energy:
K.E. scalar hai, is liye is formula mein velocities ko components mein torne ki zaroorat nahi; seedhi speed lagti hai.
Final Kinetic Energy (aakhri kinetic energy)
Collision ke baad (jab cheezen chipak jayen) total kinetic energy:
Yahan vf final velocity ki magnitude hai jo Eq. (2.41) se milti hai.
Energy Loss in the Collision (collision mein energy ka loss)
Collision inelastic hai, is liye kinetic energy kam hoti hai; is kami ko ΔK.E. kehte hain:
Yeh lost kinetic energy doosri forms mein badal jati hai, jaise heat, sound ya deformation (shakal ka bigarna).
m₁, m₂, M aur v₁i², v₂i², vf² ko equations (2.43) aur (2.44) mein rakh kar collision se pehle aur baad ki kinetic energy aur lost energy nikal sakte hain.
Some examples of an inelastic collision (inelastic collision ki kuch misalein):

items: Karate chop (haath ka waar) eenton ka dher torta hai: yeh inelastic collision hai. Collision ke baad cheezen wapas nahi uchhaltin; waar ki kuch energy eenten absorb kar (jazb kar) leti hain, jo heat, sound aur eenten torne wali force ban jati hai. Yani energy haath ko wapas uchhalne ke bajaye eenten torne mein lagti hai. Agar chop bilkul vertical (seedha neeche) na ho aur kuch horizontal motion bhi ho, to momentum transfer (aage jana) aur forces ke horizontal aur vertical dono components honge.

Car crash (hadse) mein collision horizontal aur vertical dono directions mein inelastic hota hai. Gariyan collision ki energy absorb kar ke pichak jati hain aur shakal badalti hai (deform hoti hain). Isi wajah se woh dheemi ho jati hain aur wapas nahi uchhaltin. Zyada tar kinetic energy heat, sound aur gariyon ke damage (nuqsan) mein chali jati hai.

Bat aur ball bhi inelastic collision dikhate hain. Bat ball ko maare to ball dabti hai aur kuch kinetic energy lost hoti hai; kuch energy heat aur sound ban jati hai. Bat rigid (sakht) hai phir bhi poori energy aage nahi deta, kuch khud absorb karta hai. Ball ke dabne (compress hone) se aur energy lost hoti hai. Is liye shuru ki saari kinetic energy conserved nahi rehti aur collision inelastic hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 kg ki body x-axis ke saath 3 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai aur x se 90° par 3 m s⁻¹ se chalti 1 kg ki body se chipak jati hai. Common velocity aur lost energy nikalein.
blocks.explanation: x: 2 × 3 + 0 = 3vf cos φ = 6; y: 0 + 1 × 3 = 3vf sin φ = 3. Is liye vf = √(6² + 3²)/3 = √45/3 = 2.24 m s⁻¹ aur φ = tan⁻¹(3/6) = 26.6°. (K.E)i = ½(2)(9) + ½(1)(9) = 13.5 J; (K.E)f = ½(3)(5) = 7.5 J; 6 J heat, sound aur deformation mein lost.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Do bodies origin par chipakti hain: momentum x (2.39) aur y (2.40) dono mein conserved; vf = squares ke sum ka square root ÷ M (2.41), φ = tan⁻¹(y/x) (2.42); pehle (2.43) aur baad (2.44) ki K.E. ka farq heat, sound aur deformation ka loss hai. Examples: karate chop, car crash, bat aur ball.
